Name: No Fence Decay
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]No Fence Decay

[/size]Makes all fences and gates last forever by repairing them to full health every morning. Works with fences and gates placed anywhere, on all fence types.

Requires [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI v2.9+[/url].

Place the NoFenceDecay folder inside of the Mods folder which is inside Stardew Valley.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI v2.9+.
